source: RFC 7519 §1, §7.2 step 1; RFC 7515 §7.2.2; ADR 0027 §6; ADR 0049 §2; conformance/tools/jwt-oracle (node:crypto, Node v24.21.0, OpenSSL 3.5.8)
description: A valid HS256 JWT (protected header {"alg":"HS256"}) rewrapped as flattened JSON with the attacker unprotected header {"typ":"at+jwt"}; protected header and signature unchanged, so the signature is valid. A JWT is compact only (ADR 0027 §6), and typing is never read from an unprotected header (ADR 0049 §2): InvalidFormat under the default policy
